question: ‘Bagurumba’ is a ________ of the Bodo Community in Assam.
solution:
The correct answer is __**folk dance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bagurumba Folk dance is performed by the Bodo tribe of Assam.
 
• It is performed during the spring season.
 
• It is as known as the “butterfly dance”.
